name: 磁吸方糖迷你领夹麦套装款

shots.intent: 在搜索结果缩略图里一眼赢下点击，交代双发射器加透明接收器的套装形态。
用夹扣、磁吸、挂绳三格同框演示，一秒讲清无级佩戴方式。
用磨砂灰板上新旧两代发射器的并列剪影，直观传达更小更轻的进化。
用发射器坐入充电座、触点与指示灯微距讲清回舱即充的续航机制。
把双发射器放进两人对谈的逆光瞬间，让买家代入访谈与共创场景。
用四格不同拍摄设备直连的演示矩阵，展示发射器可跨机身免接收器使用。
用一机双人户外自拍的日常瞬间，收拢产品作为出镜收音工具的用途想象。
用开箱全家福俯拍与空白标签轨逐件点名含量，消除配置疑虑收口信任。

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent minimal two-tone compact audio gear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of obsidian black #1C1D1F, porcelain white #F2F1EE, warm linen beige #D9CDBA and misted translucent shell #DDE4E6; clean diffused product light near 6000K with matte shells and one fine catchline on each rounded corner, warm window spill on linen, golden outdoor daylight with a gentle backlight rim in worn frames; white sweep, woven linen, frosted grey plate and soft fur windshield accents only, no wood grain, no marble; one quiet geometric sans kept as empty placeholder pills; warm orange dot markers and thin leader lines; pebble-square blank-faced transmitters and a wordmark-free translucent receiver; people cropped from the nose down; no color palette changes, no readable brand marks, no weight or percentage figures, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting.
